name: Use constructor injection and explicit service lifetimes
statement: Register infrastructure at the composition root and inject required collaborators through constructors; do not use service location or instantiate stateful infrastructure inside domain and orchestration services.
rationale: Explicit dependencies make lifetime, ownership, and test substitution reviewable. Quality Studio composes sensors and review services in the API host and passes them through constructors.

history.change: Initial DI rule grounded in the Quality Studio API composition root and constructor-injected services.
